body:
My entry says the orchard crew rinsed its sprayer upstream. The water turned milky, and my hands blistered where the irrigation ran across the beds.

I thought the date would settle it. Every row we watered that week yellowed from the edges in.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow.
title: Notebook page

body: The survivalist had packed for a three-day hike along the official safe corridor. At its first crossing a new barrier sent him back toward the town he had left. He wrote the change in the margin so he would not trust the printed route again.
title: Notebook page
